تعتقدي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِدِي (taʕtaqidī) /taʕ.ta.qi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# تُعْتَقَدِي (tuʕtaqadī) /tuʕ.ta.qa.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
